# Central Penn Business Journal

> > Central Penn Business Journal is the leading business news publication covering commerce, economic development, and industry trends across Central Pennsylvania.

The publication provides comprehensive coverage of regional business news, including economic policy analysis, industry developments, workforce trends, and business recognition programs. CPBJ serves as a vital resource for business leaders, entrepreneurs, and economic stakeholders throughout the Central Pennsylvania region.

## Key Topics

- Central Pennsylvania business news
- Pennsylvania commerce and economic development
- Regional business awards and recognition
- Electric choice and energy policy
- Manufacturing and industrial development
- Banking and financial services
- Workforce and employment trends
- Business regulation and policy
- Commercial real estate development
- Hospitality and restaurant industry
- Technology and business innovation
- Insurance and risk management
